route.instructions: Which track fits the candidate best. Judge from what the role actually does day to day, not from incidental JD keywords

criteria.backend_engineer: API/service design, distributed systems, databases, reliability
criteria.platform_engineer: Internal developer platforms, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, Kubernetes
criteria.site_reliability: SLOs, incident response, observability, on-call for production systems
criteria.engineering_manager: People management, planning, hiring, delivery accountability

domain.instructions: Posting needs hands-on backend/platform/distributed-systems work the candidate has done

customer_face.instructions: Needs stakeholder-facing discovery, demos, pilots, or cross-team handoff

blocker.instructions: Has hard blocker: required clearance, quota carrying, management-track-only, or language the candidate does not have

transferable.instructions: Even without an exact domain match, at least two of the candidate's core strengths (Python/Go, AWS, Postgres, Kubernetes, CI/CD, incident response, mentoring) transfer to this posting

stretch_gap.instructions: The biggest gap is one the candidate could close within about 90 days of hands-on work (preferred-vs-required, learnable tooling, adjacent domain)
